modules.name: Galaxy XR face tracking relay
modules.description: Headset-side face/eye relay for VRCFaceTracking. Runs gxr_alvr as root at boot and streams the full face/eye parameter set (incl. TongueRoll) over UDP 41463. Source and releases: compdoge/gxr-root-ft.

modules.name: Galaxy XR display-off on eye loss
modules.description: Blanks both panels (or sleeps) after the eyes are gone for the set delay and restores them on eyes; WebUI to pick the mode and delay.

modules.name: Galaxy XR hand tracking toggle
modules.description: Action button toggles whether the headset can switch its active input mode to hand tracking, by live-patching surfaceflinger's own process memory. Confirmed live: fixes controllers losing tracking on grip release.
